english.title: Aid / abet / counsel / procure the use of a television receiver without a licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to

english.legislation: Contrary to section 363(2) and (4) of the Communications Act 2003 and section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980.
